summary.text: Customers find these earbuds comfortable, with one noting they're easy to sleep in, and appreciate their sound quality, with one mentioning clear phone calls. The earbuds fit well and stay in place, while offering good value for money. Customers disagree on the battery life, with some saying it lasts a long time while others report it doesn't stay charged. Functionality and connectivity receive mixed reviews - while some say they work well with glasses, others report the left earpiece stops working, and while they connect easily, some experience disconnecting issues.
